def execute_idle_transfiguration_jujutsu(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Mahito changes a person's body by manipulating their soul through touch.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED

    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    soul = resolve_target_soul_entity(target)
    assert soul_is_affected_by_this_ability(soul, rules)
    apply_named_soul_operation(soul, healing_binding_damage_or_extract)
    mirror_effect_to_body_only_if_lore_requires(soul.owner)
    record_persistence_and_release_rules()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS

def execute_self_embodiment_of_perfection_jujutsu(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Mahito's domain makes contact with souls through his technique's guaranteed-hit application.

    zone = spawn_persistent_region(actor,target_point,shape)

        occupants = query_entities_entering_or_inside(zone)
        apply_defined_effects_per_occupant_tick(occupants,zone)
    on_exit_or_end: remove_only_owned_status_instances(zone)
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
